title: stifftia fruticosa
intro: Stifftia fruticosa, commonly known as Yellowtop or Golden top, is a flowering plant native to the Americas, specifically in the Andean region. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Stifftia fruticosa include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
